  validationRules:
    - id: agreement-date-present
      severity: error
      description: agreement_date is required for Property Management Agreement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: agreement_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: agreement_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: agreement_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(agreement_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: owner-name-present
      severity: error
      description: owner_name is required for Property Management Agreement extraction.
      rule:

    - id: management-start-date-present

    - id: management-fee-terms-present

      description: management_fee_terms is required for Property Management Agreement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and

          - op: present
            field: management_fee_terms
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: management_fee_terms

              value: 0
      sourceExpression: management_fee_terms IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(management_fee_terms)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: termination-notice-days-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: termination_notice_days should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: termination_notice_days
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: termination_notice_days
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: termination_notice_days IS NULL OR termination_notice_days >= 0
      supported: true
